    static class FastIO {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final OutputStream out;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        private int ptr = 0, len = 0;

        public FastIO(InputStream in, OutputStream out) {
            this.in = in;
            this.out = out;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = in.read(buffer);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            int c;
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            while ((c = read()) != -1 && c != '\n') {
                sb.append((char) c);
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c, val = 0;
            while ((c = read()) != -1 && c <= ' ') {}
            boolean neg = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                c = read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return neg ? -val : val;
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            int c;
            long val = 0;
            while ((c = read()) != -1 && c <= ' ') {}
            boolean neg = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                c = read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return neg ? -val : val;
        }

        public void print(String s) throws IOException {
            for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
                out.write(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }

        public void println(String s) throws IOException {
            print(s);
            out.write('\n');
        }

        public void println(int x) throws IOException {
            print(String.valueOf(x));
            out.write('\n');
        }

        public void println(long x) throws IOException {
            print(String.valueOf(x));
            out.write('\n');
        }

        public void flush() throws IOException {
            out.flush();
        }
    }

    static class TreeNode {
        int key;
        int value;
        TreeNode left;
        TreeNode right;
        TreeNode parent;
        int height;
        int num_left;
        int num_total;

        TreeNode(int k, int v) {
            key = k;
            value = v;
            height = 1;
            num_left = 1;
            num_total = 1;
        }
    }

    static class AvlTree {
        TreeNode _tree;

        AvlTree() {
            _tree = null;
        }

        void add(int k, int v) {
            if (_tree == null) {
                _tree = new TreeNode(k, v);
                return;
            }
            TreeNode node = _add(k, v);
            if (node != null) {
                _rebalance(node);
            }
        }

        TreeNode _add(int k, int v) {
            TreeNode node = _tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (k < node.key) {
                    if (node.left != null) {
                        node = node.left;
                    } else {
                        node.left = new TreeNode(k, v);
                        node.left.parent = node;
                        return node.left;
                    }
                } else if (node.key < k) {
                    if (node.right != null) {
                        node = node.right;
                    } else {
                        node.right = new TreeNode(k, v);
                        node.right.parent = node;
                        return node.right;
                    }
                } else {
                    node.value = v;
                    return node;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        static int getHeight(TreeNode x) {
            return x != null ? x.height : 0;
        }

        static int getNumTotal(TreeNode x) {
            return x != null ? x.num_total : 0;
        }

        void _rebalance(TreeNode node) {
            TreeNode n = node;
            while (n != null) {
                int lh = getHeight(n.left);
                int rh = getHeight(n.right);
                n.height = Math.max(lh, rh) + 1;
                int balanceFactor = lh - rh;
                n.num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(n.left) + getNumTotal(n.right);
                n.num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(n.left);

                if (balanceFactor > 1) {
                    if (getHeight(n.left.left) < getHeight(n.left.right)) {
                        _rotate_left(n.left);
                    }
                    _rotate_right(n);
                } else if (balanceFactor < -1) {
                    if (getHeight(n.right.right) < getHeight(n.right.left)) {
                        _rotate_right(n.right);
                    }
                    _rotate_left(n);
                } else {
                    n = n.parent;
                }
            }
        }

        void _remove_one(TreeNode node) {
            TreeNode replacement = node.left != null ? node.left : node.right;
            if (node.parent != null) {
                if (isLeft(node)) {
                    node.parent.left = replacement;
                } else {
                    node.parent.right = replacement;
                }
                if (replacement != null) {
                    replacement.parent = node.parent;
                }
                node.parent = null;
            } else {
                _tree = replacement;
                if (replacement != null) {
                    replacement.parent = null;
                }
            }
            node.left = null;
            node.right = null;
            node.parent = null;
            if (replacement != null) {
                _rebalance(replacement);
            }
        }

        void _remove_leaf(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent != null) {
                if (isLeft(node)) {
                    node.parent.left = null;
                } else {
                    node.parent.right = null;
                }
                _rebalance(node.parent);
            } else {
                _tree = null;
            }
            node.parent = null;
            node.left = null;
            node.right = null;
        }

        void remove(int k) {
            TreeNode node = _get_node(k);
            if (node == null) return;
            if (isLeaf(node)) {
                _remove_leaf(node);
                return;
            }
            if (node.left != null && node.right != null) {
                TreeNode nxt = get_next(node);
                node.key = nxt.key;
                node.value = nxt.value;
                if (isLeaf(nxt)) {
                    _remove_leaf(nxt);
                } else {
                    _remove_one(nxt);
                }
                _rebalance(node);
            } else {
                _remove_one(node);
            }
        }

        int get(int k) {
            TreeNode node = _get_node(k);
            return node != null ? node.value : -1;
        }

        TreeNode _get_node(int k) {
            if (_tree == null) return null;
            TreeNode node = _tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (k < node.key) {
                    node = node.left;
                } else if (node.key < k) {
                    node = node.right;
                } else {
                    return node;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        int[] get_at(int pos) {
            int x = pos + 1;
            TreeNode node = _tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (x < node.num_left) {
                    node = node.left;
                } else if (node.num_left < x) {
                    x -= node.num_left;
                    node = node.right;
                } else {
                    return new int[]{node.key, node.value};
                }
            }
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Out of ranges");
        }

        static boolean isLeft(TreeNode node) {
            return node.parent != null && node.parent.left == node;
        }

        static boolean isLeaf(TreeNode node) {
            return node.left == null && node.right == null;
        }

        void _rotate_right(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent == null) {
                _tree = node.left;
                node.left.parent = null;
            } else if (isLeft(node)) {
                node.parent.left = node.left;
                node.left.parent = node.parent;
            } else {
                node.parent.right = node.left;
                node.left.parent = node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode bk = node.left.right;
            node.left.right = node;
            node.parent = node.left;
            node.left = bk;
            if (bk != null) {
                bk.parent = node;
            }
            node.height = Math.max(getHeight(node.left), getHeight(node.right)) + 1;
            node.num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left) + getNumTotal(node.right);
            node.num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left);
        }

        void _rotate_left(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent == null) {
                _tree = node.right;
                node.right.parent = null;
            } else if (isLeft(node)) {
                node.parent.left = node.right;
                node.right.parent = node.parent;
            } else {
                node.parent.right = node.right;
                node.right.parent = node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode bk = node.right.left;
            node.right.left = node;
            node.parent = node.right;
            node.right = bk;
            if (bk != null) {
                bk.parent = node;
            }
            node.height = Math.max(getHeight(node.left), getHeight(node.right)) + 1;
            node.num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left) + getNumTotal(node.right);
            node.num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left);
        }

        static TreeNode get_next(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.right == null) {
                return node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode n = node.right;
            while (n.left != null) {
                n = n.left;
            }
            return n;
        }
    }

    static class SegmentTree1 {
        int[] data;
        int _default;
        int _len;
        int _size;
        java.util.function.BinaryOperator<Integer> func;

        SegmentTree1(int[] data, int defaultVal, java.util.function.BinaryOperator<Integer> func) {
            _default = defaultVal;
            _func = func;
            _len = data.length;
            _size = 1;
            while (_size < _len) _size <<= 1;

            this.data = new int[2 * _size];
            for (int i = 0; i < _len; i++) {
                this.data[_size + i] = data[i];
            }
            for (int i = _size - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                this.data[i] = _func.apply(this.data[2 * i], this.data[2 * i + 1]);
            }
        }

        int _func(int a, int b) {
            return Math.min(a, b);
        }

        int query(int start, int stop) {
            if (start == stop) return data[start + _size];
            stop++;
            start += _size;
            stop += _size;

            int res = _default;
            while (start < stop) {
                if ((start & 1) == 1) {
                    res = _func.apply(res, data[start]);
                    start++;
                }
                if ((stop & 1) == 1) {
                    stop--;
                    res = _func.apply(res, data[stop]);
                }
                start >>= 1;
                stop >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static class Factorial {
        int MOD;
        long[] factorials;
        long[] invModulos;
        long[] invFactorial_;

        Factorial(int MOD) {
            this.MOD = MOD;
            factorials = new long[]{1, 1};
            invModulos = new long[]{0, 1};
            invFactorial_ = new long[]{1, 1};
        }

        long calc(int n) {
            if (n <= -1) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate n!");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            if (n < factorials.length) return factorials[n];
            long[] nextArr = new long[n + 1 - factorials.length];
            int initialI = factorials.length;
            long prev = factorials[factorials.length - 1];
            long m = MOD;
            for (int i = initialI; i <= n; i++) {
                prev = nextArr[i - initialI] = (prev * i) % m;
            }
            long[] newFactorials = new long[n + 1];
            System.arraycopy(factorials, 0, newFactorials, 0, factorials.length);
            System.arraycopy(nextArr, 0, newFactorials, factorials.length, nextArr.length);
            factorials = newFactorials;
            return factorials[n];
        }

        long inv(int n) {
            if (n <= -1) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate n^(-1)");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            long p = MOD;
            long pi = n % p;
            if (pi < invModulos.length) return invModulos[(int) pi];
            long[] nextArr = new long[n + 1 - invModulos.length];
            int initialI = invModulos.length;
            for (int i = initialI; i < Math.min((int) p, n + 1); i++) {
                long next = -invModulos[(int) (p % i)] * (p / i) % p;
                if (next < 0) next += p;
                invModulos = append(invModulos, next);
            }
            return invModulos[(int) pi];
        }

        long invFactorial(int n) {
            if (n <= -1) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate (n^(-1))!");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            if (n < invFactorial_.length) return invFactorial_[n];
            inv(n);
            long[] nextArr = new long[n + 1 - invFactorial_.length];
            int initialI = invFactorial_.length;
            long prev = invFactorial_[invFactorial_.length - 1];
            long p = MOD;
            for (int i = initialI; i <= n; i++) {
                prev = nextArr[i - initialI] = (prev * invModulos[i % (int) p]) % p;
            }
            long[] newInvFactorial = new long[n + 1];
            System.arraycopy(invFactorial_, 0, newInvFactorial, 0, invFactorial_.length);
            System.arraycopy(nextArr, 0, newInvFactorial, invFactorial_.length, nextArr.length);
            invFactorial_ = newInvFactorial;
            return invFactorial_[n];
        }

        private long[] append(long[] arr, long val) {
            long[] newArr = new long[arr.length + 1];
            System.arraycopy(arr, 0, newArr, 0, arr.length);
            newArr[arr.length] = val;
            return newArr;
        }
    }

    static class Combination {
        int MOD;
        Factorial factorial;

        Combination(int MOD) {
            this.MOD = MOD;
            factorial = new Factorial(MOD);
        }

        long ncr(int n, int k) {
            if (k < 0 || n < k) return 0;
            k = Math.min(k, n - k);
            Factorial f = factorial;
            return (f.calc(n) * f.invFactorial(Math.max(n - k, k)) % MOD * f.invFactorial(Math.min(k, n - k)) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static long powm(long a, long n, long m) {
        if (a == 1 || n == 0) return 1;
        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            long s = powm(a, n / 2, m);
            return (s * s) % m;
        } else {
            return (a * powm(a, n - 1, m)) % m;
        }
    }

    static int binarySearchCount(int[] arr, int n, int key) {
        int left = 0, right = n - 1, count = 0;
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (right + left) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] <= key) {
                count = mid + 1;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastIO io = new FastIO(System.in, System.out);
        String[] line1 = io.nextLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        String[] line2 = io.nextLine().split(" ");
        int[] l = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            l[i] = Integer.parseInt(line2[i]) % k;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            io.println(l[0]);
            io.flush();
            return;
        }
        int[] l1 = new int[n / 2];
        int[] l2 = new int[n - n / 2];
        System.arraycopy(l, 0, l1, 0, n / 2);
        System.arraycopy(l, n / 2, l2, 0, n - n / 2);
        TreeSet<Integer> s = new TreeSet<>();
        TreeSet<Integer> s1 = new TreeSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            TreeSet<Integer> s2 = new TreeSet<>();
            for (int j : s) {
                s2.add((j + l1[i]) % k);
            }
            s.add(l1[i]);
            for (int j : s2) {
                s.add(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n - n / 2; i++) {
            TreeSet<Integer> s2 = new TreeSet<>();
            for (int j : s1) {
                s2.add((j + l2[i]) % k);
            }
            s1.add(l2[i]);
            for (int j : s2) {
                s1.add(j);
            }
        }
        int[] arrS = s.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
        int[] arrS1 = s1.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
        int ans = Math.max(arrS.length > 0 ? arrS[arrS.length - 1] : 0, arrS1.length > 0 ? arrS1[arrS1.length - 1] : 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < arrS.length; i++) {
            int t = k - 1 - arrS[i];
            int ind = binarySearchCount(arrS1, arrS1.length, t);
            if (ind > 0) {
                int r = arrS1[ind - 1];
                int rt = arrS1[arrS1.length - 1];
                ans = Math.max(Math.max((r + arrS[i]) % k, (arrS[i] + rt) % k), ans);
            }
        }
        io.println(ans);
        io.flush();
    }
